raw:
Seraphel loosens the ribbon around the slim book and turns its cover toward you: *Survey Across the Red Waste*.

“An expedition journal by a surveyor who crossed sand.  
He lost his map, insulted a prince, and blamed the prince’s land.”

She takes the chair opposite yours, careful of the brittle pages.
